evals.prompt: triage-agent.js runs support triage as an agent loop; recorded-runs.json holds its outputs from production. Convert it into a deterministic workflow, keeping a model only where judgment is genuinely needed.
evals.expected_output: A rewrite where email extraction, customer lookup, and queue routing are plain code with tests, control flow is fixed in code, only the summary remains a model call with a typed, validated output and an explicit failure branch, and the new routing is compared against recorded-runs.json
expectations: The agent lists the workflow steps and classifies each as deterministic or judgment before rewriting
Header parsing, customer lookup, and queue routing by plan and keywords become plain code, not model calls

The agent names the cases the prompt leaves to the model (an enterprise customer asking for a refund matches two rules; an enterprise ticket with no keywords; a sender not found; a ticket with no From: header) and resolves each explicitly or asks, rather than guessing
The order of steps and the stop condition live in code; the unbounded agent loop is removed
The summary step is the only model call, with a typed output validated against a schema instead of regex-parsed text
A validation failure takes an explicit branch and is not retried automatically
Tests cover the deterministic steps and run with the model call replaced by a fake
The new routing runs on every ticket in recorded-runs.json; each ticket where the recorded runs disagree (T-102, T-103, T-104) is reported with the rule the new code applies

expectations: The agent does not implement the change by adding a sentence to SYSTEM_PROMPT
Queue routing, including the new retention rule, becomes a function in code with tests
The precedence between retention and the existing rules is stated explicitly or asked about
